metadata.description: Medianoche UTC vigente o siguiente, ISO 8601.

properties.description: MDCAI V3 - volumen diario por AlertType; no cubre taxonomías.

ruleDefinition.query:
// Azure Monitor summary rule. Su bin determina el rango; no agregar ago()/now().
SecurityAlert
| where ProductName in~ ("Azure Security Center", "Microsoft Defender for Cloud")
| where AlertType startswith_cs "AI.Azure_" or AlertType startswith_cs "AI.AIModelScan_"
| where isnotempty(SystemAlertId)
| extend DiaUTC=startofday(TimeGenerated)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertType, AlertSeverity) by DiaUTC, TenantId, SystemAlertId
| summarize Alertas=count(), SeveridadAlta=countif(AlertSeverity =~ "High") by DiaUTC, AlertType
ruleDefinition.displayName: MDCAI V3 diario por tipo de alerta
